description: This is a PHP source file defining an 'Antispam' model class within the Opencart admin module, providing CRUD operations and querying functionality for antispam keywords.

classes.name: Antispam
classes.description: Model class for managing antispam keywords in the OpenCart admin module.

methods.name: addAntispam
methods.description: Insert a new antispam keyword into the database. Returns the last inserted ID.

methods.name: editAntispam
methods.description: Update an existing antispam keyword by its ID.

methods.name: deleteAntispam
methods.description: Delete an antispam keyword by its ID.

methods.name: getAntispam
methods.description: Retrieve a specific antispam record by its ID.

methods.name: getAntispams
methods.description: Retrieve a list of antispam records with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalAntispams
methods.description: Count the total number of antispam records matching optional filters.
